class.description: `SemanticStructure3D`: The 3D `Control` Functional Shell Node (`Surface -> Wall/Floor/Seat -> Chair`, `Aperture -> Door/Window`, `Organic -> Trunk/Branch`). Holds a 3D Box-Model (`rest_obb_extents`, `margin_extents`, `size_flags`), `SemanticRoleID`, `SemanticTagSetResource`, and `Theme3DResource`, and smartly applies resolved styles and bounds to its Godot children. Part of IdeamDesign (3D CSS themes, layouts, parametric assemblies, and architectural blueprints).
